Ted Brown

Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senator, Texas · Open seat

Independent insurance adjuster

Vice chair of the Libertarian Party of Travis County and a party member for nearly 50 years, including as former chair of the Libertarian Party of California. B.A. in political science from UCLA.

Where Brown stands

Gas tax
Would repeal the federal gas tax entirely.
Data centers
Generally opposes regulation but sees merit in requiring power and water plans and banning taxpayer subsidies and eminent domain.
Iran and war powers
Supports every war powers resolution and wants U.S. troops withdrawn from the Middle East.
Border wall in Big Bend
Wants Congress to bar a wall in Big Bend and stop further border wall construction.
Gender care for minors
Opposes government control over doctor-patient decisions; does not advocate surgery for minors.
Marijuana and hemp
Wants cannabis removed from federal drug scheduling and past marijuana convictions expunged.
Tariffs
Says only Congress can set tariffs; supports free trade.

Background

  • Vice chair, Libertarian Party of Travis County
  • Former chair, Libertarian Party of California
  • B.A., UCLA, 1984
